Method of Attack: Delivered as obfuscated .NET binary ransomware that encrypts personal files, deletes backup copies and backup catalog, disables recovery mode and Task Manager, and demands ransom payment in Bitcoin
Copies itself to %Appdata% as svchost.exe to evade detection
Removes Volume Shadow copies and Windows Backup catalog to prevent recovery
Disables Task Manager via Windows Registry modification
Encrypts user-accessible files with predefined extensions and appends random four-character extension
Drops ransom note read_it.txt in encrypted directories
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user-accessible file directories
Attack Vector: Obfuscated .NET binary executed on Windows, evasion by location check and renaming to svchost.exe
Indicators of Compromise: Command lines: Vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet, Wmic shadowcopy delete, Wbadmin delete catalog –quiet
